spraay-scheduler 1.0.0

- Initial release of the spraay-scheduler skill.
- Lets users create, list, and cancel recurring reminder schedules via the Spraay Protocol gateway.
- Sends signed cron.triggered webhooks to user-controlled HTTPS addresses as scheduled reminders (no automatic payments).
- Requires explicit user approval and payment for each create ($0.10), list, or cancel ($0.002) action.
- Refuses to process batch payments, payroll execution, or any payment request—skill is limited to schedule management and webhook verification.
